# SZL Holdings — Public Mirror Exclusion List

**Version:** 1.0  
**Date:** April 2026  
**Generated by:** GitHub Overhaul Phase 1  
**Authority:** Stephen Lutar, Founder

---

## Purpose

This is the canonical exclusion list for the `szl-holdings-platform` public mirror. It enumerates every path, pattern, and content category that must not appear in a public mirror push. It is the source of truth for `.gitignore` rules and mirror script logic.

---

## 1. Root-Level Directory Exclusions

| Directory | Risk | Reason | Enforced By |
|-----------|------|--------|-------------|
| `.archive/` | MEDIUM | Historical/archived work — internal cleanup artifacts | `.gitignore`, mirror scripts |
| `.git-rewrite/` | HIGH | Git history rewrite state — internal operation | `.gitignore`, mirror scripts |
| `backups/` | CRITICAL | Database backups with SQL dumps — sensitive data | `.gitignore`, mirror scripts |
| `exports/` | MEDIUM | Internal export artifacts | `.gitignore`, mirror scripts |
| `test-results/` | MEDIUM | CI/test output — operational noise | `.gitignore`, mirror scripts |
| `attached_assets/` | HIGH | Raw user-uploaded files — unsorted, unvetted | `.gitignore`, mirror scripts |
| `social-content/` | MEDIUM | Draft social media content — not publication-ready | `.gitignore`, mirror scripts |
| `spfx-webparts/` | MEDIUM | SharePoint web parts — internal tooling | `.gitignore`, mirror scripts |
| `.local/` | HIGH | Replit agent workspace — task files, session plans | `.gitignore`, mirror scripts |
| `.cache/` | LOW | Build cache — transient artifacts | `.gitignore`, mirror scripts |
| `.canvas/` | LOW | Canvas editor state — Replit workspace feature | `.gitignore`, mirror scripts |
| `.cursor/` | LOW | Cursor editor state | `.gitignore`, mirror scripts |
| `.upm/` | LOW | Replit package manager state | `.gitignore`, mirror scripts |
| `.config/` | LOW | Replit internal config | `.gitignore`, mirror scripts |
| `.agents/` | MEDIUM | Replit agent configuration | `.gitignore`, mirror scripts |
| `node_modules/` | LOW | Dependencies — install via `pnpm install` | `.gitignore`, mirror scripts |
| `dist/` | LOW | Build output — built from source | `.gitignore`, mirror scripts |
| `scratch/` | HIGH | Developer scratch work | `.gitignore`, mirror scripts |
| `temp/`, `tmp/` | MEDIUM | Temporary files | `.gitignore`, mirror scripts |

## 3. File Pattern Exclusions

### Secret Material

| Pattern | Risk | Reason |
|---------|------|--------|
| `.env` | CRITICAL | Live environment secrets |
| `.env.*` | CRITICAL | Scoped environment secrets |
| `*.env` | CRITICAL | Misplaced environment files |
| `.env.local` | CRITICAL | Local environment secrets |
| `.env.*.local` | CRITICAL | Scoped local secrets |

### Database Artifacts

| Pattern | Risk | Reason |
|---------|------|--------|
| `*.sql.gz` | CRITICAL | Compressed SQL dump files |
| `*.dump` | CRITICAL | PostgreSQL dump files |
| `*.pgdump` | CRITICAL | PostgreSQL dump files (alternate extension) |

### Backup Files

| Pattern | Risk | Reason |
|---------|------|--------|
| `*.bak` | MEDIUM | Backup files |
| `*.backup` | MEDIUM | Backup files (alternate extension) |

### Build Artifacts

| Pattern | Risk | Reason |
|---------|------|--------|
| `*.tsbuildinfo` | LOW | TypeScript build cache |
| `coverage/` | LOW | Test coverage output |

### Runtime Output

| Pattern | Risk | Reason |
|---------|------|--------|
| `*.log` | LOW | Runtime log files |

| `.github/instructions/` | Replit agent GitHub instructions — internal |

## 5. Nested Exclusion Checks

The validation script also checks for excluded directories appearing nested inside included directories (e.g., `artifacts/some-app/backups/`). These must also be absent from the staged mirror.

---

## 6. Enforcement Summary

| Mechanism | When It Runs | What It Catches |
|-----------|-------------|----------------|
| `.gitignore` | Every git operation | Prevents excluded content from being staged or committed |
| `report-public-surface.ts` | Before staging | Inventories workspace — flags noisy/excluded items |
| `prepare-public-mirror.ts` | During staging | Applies allowlist — only copies explicitly included paths |
| `validate-public-surface.ts` | After staging | Scans staging dir — hard error on any exclusion found |
| Human checklist | Before push | Final human review per `docs/public/public-mirror-policy.md` |
